tools.name: sarcire_preview
tools.description: Get a quick fix preview for a build or runtime error. Returns whether a vector-matched fix exists and a one-line summary. Fast — use this before every retry.

error_text.description: Full error output (stderr / stack trace). Up to 5000 chars.

context_id.description: Optional correlation ID (PR number, build ID, etc.).

tools.name: sarcire_get_fix
tools.description: Get full fix steps for a build or runtime error. Returns structured, ordered steps with code hints. Credits consumed on novel generation.

error_text.description: Full error output (stderr / stack trace). Up to 5000 chars.

context_id.description: Optional correlation ID (PR number, build ID, etc.).
